implementation.kind: Rust port through the controlled WASM SDK; no native provider crate dependency
changes: Controlled network, clock, randomness, account CAS, locks and per-flow/per-account state
Strict AWS prelude/message CRC32 and bounded frame/header/payload validation
Missing token/credit readings remain unknown, not invented estimates or zero
Managed loopback and local credential helpers are explicitly gated until real host support exists
